findings.title: Payment Terms and Invoicing Requirements
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines the pricing structure, invoicing requirements, and conditions under which charges can be made, ensuring clarity and predictability in financial transactions between the Vendor and Client.
evidence_excerpts: All invoices raised by the Vendor shall strictly correspond to the pricing categories and values stated in this Agreement.

findings.title: Pricing Structure Overview
findings.rationale: The evidence provides a comprehensive overview of the pricing structure, including device pricing frameworks, service rates, and cost components, ensuring clarity and predictability for the Client.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall provide the Client with a meticulously detailed device pricing framework that lists the per-unit cost of every hardware category supplied under this collaboration.

findings.title: Price Escalation Clauses Present
findings.rationale: The contract includes specific clauses regarding price protection and escalation constraints, detailing how and when price adjustments can occur, as well as the conditions under which they are permissible.
evidence_excerpts: Accordingly, all hardware prices, deployment prices, and service prices defined within this Agreement shall remain protected for a minimum of twelve months from the date of execution.

findings.title: Renewal Pricing and Terms
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that any pricing amendments must be documented through a written addendum, and the Vendor will continue to honor all accepted purchase orders based on the current rate card until a new version is formally transitioned. This indicates that renewal pricing is tied to the existing rate card unless formally amended.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall continue to honour all accepted purchase orders based on the current rate card until the Parties formally transition to a new version.

findings.title: Cap on Financial Exposure and Charges
findings.rationale: The contract explicitly prohibits the introduction of new financial charges outside the agreed terms, ensuring that the Client is protected from unexpected financial exposure.
evidence_excerpts: The Client shall not be obligated to pay for resource wait times, idle engineer hours, or vendor-driven deployment delays. This protects the Client from unexpected financial exposure and ensures absolute commercial predictability throughout the contract term.
